title: Artificial Neural Network Algorithms to Predict Resting Energy Expenditure in Critically Ill Children
summary: Artificial neural networks estimated resting energy expenditure in 257 critically ill children against indirect calorimetry. Accuracy was 82.3% when vital signs and biochemical values were included and 89.6% when measured VCO₂ was added; the study does not establish performance outside this cohort.
ai_technology: Artificial neural networks estimate resting energy expenditure in critically ill children.
organization: Department of Clinical Sciences and Community Health, University of Milan, 20122 Milan, Italy.

evidence.tested: Against indirect calorimetry in 257 critically ill children, ANN accuracy was 82.3% with clinical variables and 89.6% when measured VCO₂ was included.
evidence.unknown: No external or prospective validation beyond the 257-child study cohort was reported.
